source.title: A competitor unintentionally caused a misalignment during Megaminx inspection
source.content:
During the inspection of a Megaminx attempt, the competitor caused an unintentional misalignment to the puzzle, possibly against regulation [A3c1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#A3c1).

After careful review of the video footage ([11f](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#11f)), the WRC has decided not to DNF the attempt. None of the frames analyzed point to the face having moved beyond the allowed 36º ([10f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#10f2)).

translation.title: 选手在五魔方观察时意外造成错位
translation.content:
一名选手在五魔方观察时意外使魔方错位，可能违反 [A3c1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#A3c1)。

依据 [11f](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#11f)仔细审查视频后，WRC 决定不判 DNF。分析的各帧均未显示该面转动超过允许的 36º（[10f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#10f2)）。
